query: Who will own each short-term pilot, what specific deliverables and evaluation checkpoints should we set, and what are realistic 3- and 6-month milestones?

response.query: Who will own each short-term pilot, what specific deliverables and evaluation checkpoints should we set, and what are realistic 3- and 6-month milestones?
response.answer: Ownership of each short-term pilot will be assigned to a dedicated project manager. Deliverables include pilot launch, curriculum delivery, and evaluation reports. Three-month milestones are curriculum completion and initial feedback; six-month milestones are pilot assessment and refinement.
